item.title: Parenting Brew: The Death of the Independent Nuclear Family
item.description:
A look at raising kids in this economy...
Good morning. Today’s special edition is all about the evolving business of parenting. We’ll explain why so many young adults still financially depend on their parents, discuss the rise of platonic co-parenting (yes, that’s a thing), visit the Hogwarts for nannies (yes, that’s also a thing), and much more. Whether you’re a parent to humans, hope to be one someday, or are content with just keeping your Sims alive, there’s something for everyone in Parenting Brew.
https://www.morningbrew.com/issues/parenting-brew
